record.question: When setting up a community pharmacy, the most important criteria when choosing the pharmacy design and interiors is:
options: Fulfilling the requirements under schedule A of the Drugs and cosmetics rules, 1945.
The pharmacy should follow the colour coordination of a government hospital.
The floor area of a retail pharmacy should be at least 90 sq feet area.
Fulfilling the requirements under schedule N of the Drugs and cosmetics rules, 1945.
record.explanation: Answer D: Fulfilling the requirements under schedule N of the Drugs and cosmetics rules, 1945.. Schedule N of India’s Drugs and Cosmetics Rules specifies premises and minimum equipment requirements for efficient pharmacy operation. It requires at least 6 m² dispensing area for one pharmacist (plus 2 m² per additional pharmacist), not 90 ft². Reference: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/19158/1/2016drugsandcosmeticsact1940rules1945.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
